final: WITH g AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.dealedge AS side, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) AS avg_net, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge), s AS (SELECT g.*, AVG(avg_net) OVER (PARTITION BY side) AS side_avg FROM g) SELECT orderslink, side, avg_net, cnt, avg_net - side_avg AS diff FROM s WHERE avg_net > side_avg ORDER BY diff DESC LIMIT 10
